(3) PREMIUM PROCEDURAL SPECIALTY - advanced therapeutic endoscopy (ERCP-class interventional work), pancreatology and hepatology are among the highest-billing medical-gastroenterology sub-specialties. That is a deliberate, self-funded patient-acquisition operation. (6) PATIENT-VOLUME PROXY, quoted verbatim from his Apollo247 listing: 'recommended by 701 patients with an impressive recommendation score of 91%'. No directorship, HOD title, clinic ownership, society office or published procedure volume was found.

notes: Identity is unambiguous - 'Yegurla' is a rare surname and no rival clinician of that name exists anywhere in results. Matched on four facts: name + specialty (gastroenterology/hepatology) + hospital (Apollo, Jubilee Hills / Apollo Health City) + city, across four separate Apollo page families. PHONE HANDLED CAREFULLY - THIS IS THE KEY JUDGEMENT ON THIS ROW. A WebSearch summary offered 04069321004 as 'his' contact number. The mandatory exact-phrase re-check was run TWICE. The first check ('"04069321004" Jatin gastroenterologist') returned his own Apollo doctor page as the top result, confirming the string is genuinely published on a page belonging to him. The second, bare exact-phrase check ('"04069321004"') then returned the SAME number on the Apollo doctor pages of many unrelated Hyderabad consultants - Dr Vidyasagar Dumpala (ENT), Dr N Subrahmaneswara Babu (surgical gastro), Dr Vijay Dikshit, Dr Sanjay Kumar Agarwal and Dr A G K Gokhale (CTVS), Dr V Bramha Prasad (neurosurgery), Dr Koka Ram Babu (ENT) - plus an Apollo Financial District department page. It is therefore an APOLLO HYDERABAD CENTRAL APPOINTMENT LINE, not his own. Under the section-4 rule barring 'a hospital's central booking line recorded as if it were the doctor's own', it was NOT recorded in professional_phone; it is recorded in hospital_number, where it is honest and still actionable. This is exactly the failure mode the second exact-phrase check exists to catch. professional_email is blank: no address was published on any page. A ZoomInfo entry offering a MASKED ****@apollohospitals.com address appeared in results and was rejected outright - it is a scraped contact broker and the address is masked, barred twice over by golden rule 4. Band is Medium, NOT High, and this is the section-5 corollary applied strictly: apollohospitals.com, apollo247.com and apolloclinic.com are all ONE Apollo source no matter how many page families carry him. His own website, LinkedIn and YouTube channel corroborate strongly and are the best approach routes, but they are self-published and cannot earn High. Practo and eka.care are corroborating-only. No government, university, ORCID or Scholar source was found. DUPLICATE RECORD FLAGGED: a second Apollo247 profile for 'Dr Jatin Yegurla' is tagged to NANDED, Maharashtra (https://www.apollo247.com/doctors/dr-jatin-yegurla-6769e176-3459-4119-a9ed-fbeb1a3b8ffe). Given the rarity of the surname and identical specialty, this is almost certainly the same doctor under a mis-tagged or legacy location rather than a second person; it is recorded in other_profiles with that caveat and was not used to establish location. owns_clinic is false - he is an Apollo consultant with a marketing website, not the owner of a separate clinic entity; the Manikonda location is an Apollo Clinic, i.e. Apollo's own brand. HIGHEST-VALUE HUMAN FOLLOW-UP: open https://drjatingastro.com/ and its contact page with a browser - a self-branded practice site of this kind very often publishes a direct clinic/secretary number, a WhatsApp booking link and an enquiry email that WebSearch did not expose.
